sections.title: Healthy response test
sections.what: Calls the health check and confirms it reports the database as available.

summary: Test that the health check reports ok when the local database is reachable.
purpose: Confirms the health endpoint returns the expected healthy response.
why: Likely reason: monitoring can check that the app is running.
how: Calls the health check and expects 200 with status ok, mode synthetic-demo, and database available.
risks: Only the success case is tested. The unavailable case is not covered.
debug: If this fails, check the database ping and its configuration.
